capabilities.purpose: bounded HTTP and HTTPS transport shared by trusted C products
capabilities.destination_constraint: URL parser, scheme allowlist, DNS/IP policy, redirect non-following, and caller timeout
capabilities.credential_constraint: caller supplies a bounded header; transport never resolves credentials
capabilities.audit_disposition: transport logs metadata; governed callers remain responsible for purpose and decision evidence
capabilities.review_boundary: changes require Runtime Security and credential-custody review

capabilities.purpose: model execution, model discovery, retry, telemetry, and shadow delivery
capabilities.destination_constraint: provider configuration or a compile-time provider authority; bounded timeout on every call
capabilities.credential_constraint: Vault/config-owned provider header; no credential is accepted from model content
capabilities.audit_disposition: provider calls feed token/action audit; transport metadata excludes bodies and credentials
capabilities.review_boundary: new files or calls require provider-boundary and Audit review

capabilities.purpose: configured chat delivery, speech sidecars, webhook delivery, and polling
capabilities.destination_constraint: platform-specific fixed authority or operator-configured target with bounded timeout
capabilities.credential_constraint: gateway-owned platform credentials; message content cannot select a credential
capabilities.audit_disposition: gateway action/result audit plus metadata-only transport logs
capabilities.review_boundary: new platforms and destination widening require Gateway and Runtime Security review

capabilities.purpose: OCR/TSR sidecars and authenticated server-to-KB protocol
capabilities.destination_constraint: operator configuration or the authenticated KB endpoint; bounded timeout
capabilities.credential_constraint: sidecars receive no bearer; KB bearer is Vault-owned and scope-bound
capabilities.audit_disposition: ingest and KB governance paths emit durable outcomes; transport excludes content
capabilities.review_boundary: new KB destinations require KB and Data Authorization review

capabilities.owner: trusted server and KB core module adapters
capabilities.purpose: legacy Git discovery/API, C memory embedding, and C MCP transport
capabilities.destination_constraint: forge authority, configured embedder, or registered MCP endpoint; bounded calls
capabilities.credential_constraint: central Git credential injection, scoped configuration, or registered MCP credential
capabilities.audit_disposition: formally constrained core exception; higher-level action events are durable and transport bodies are excluded
capabilities.review_boundary: no count or file expansion without Runtime Security approval and an egress-module migration decision

capabilities.destination_constraint: public-address resolution, rebinding-resistant pinned IP, and bounded redirects
capabilities.credential_constraint: no ambient provider or forge credential
capabilities.audit_disposition: web tool decision/action audit; response content is not copied into immutable evidence
capabilities.review_boundary: destination-policy changes require Guardrails and Runtime Security review

capabilities.owner: server, KB, gateway, and local browser listener owners
capabilities.purpose: declared service listeners and loopback-only browser/forwarder listeners
capabilities.destination_constraint: bind address is fixed loopback or controlled by the owning authenticated listener configuration
capabilities.credential_constraint: inbound authentication is enforced above the accept boundary; listeners resolve no outbound credential
capabilities.audit_disposition: listener authentication/authorization paths own request audit; socket creation is not egress
capabilities.review_boundary: new Internet listeners require route, authentication, rate-limit, and deployment review

capabilities.owner: core connection and KB management transport
capabilities.purpose: DNS resolution and TLS connection for explicit client/server transport abstractions
capabilities.destination_constraint: caller-supplied endpoint parsed by the owning protocol; KB resolver applies address policy
capabilities.credential_constraint: TLS identity is supplied by the owning connection policy, not by payload content
capabilities.audit_disposition: owning protocol records outcomes; resolution and handshake do not persist addresses or credentials
capabilities.review_boundary: new resolution/handshake sites require connection-core and Runtime Security review

capabilities.owner: DB2 store and WORM delivery worker
capabilities.destination_constraint: operator DSN with required role, TLS, schema, and startup posture checks
capabilities.credential_constraint: separate runtime/migrator credentials supplied through sealed deployment configuration
capabilities.audit_disposition: store mutations and WORM delivery have transaction/durability evidence; DSNs are never logged
capabilities.review_boundary: new PostgreSQL connection owners require DB2 and Data Authorization review

capabilities.purpose: credentialed Git fetch, pull, push, clone, and forge operations
capabilities.destination_constraint: canonical repository remote/forge scope; argv-only execution and centralized URL normalization
capabilities.credential_constraint: one centralized injector, bounded principal/remote scope, memfd or encrypted egress envelope
capabilities.audit_disposition: Git action and verification outcomes are durable; plaintext tokens are excluded
capabilities.review_boundary: new credential consumers fail this ratchet and require Git, Vault, and Runtime Security review
